scope: Local source, configuration, domain, API authorization, migration, repository, fresh and populated PostgreSQL 17.10, restricted-role, audit, full repository verification, secret scan, and production dependency audit evidence for default-disabled tenant-approved restricted support diagnostics. No customer data, provider credential or request, source-system write, real support identity, real IdP/MFA enforcement, ticket-system integration, customer notification, protected staging, production deployment, legal approval, compliance, or production-readiness claim is included.

identityBoundary.durableIdentity: HMAC-SHA-256 over issuer, NUL separator, and subject

authorityWorkflow.approver: active membership with owner role and explicit support:manage permission

databaseContract.applicationAuthority: EXECUTE on five fixed SECURITY DEFINER functions only

databaseSuite.command: pnpm exec vitest run --project integration packages/database/src/*.integration.test.ts --no-file-parallelism (local-only database URLs supplied through environment and omitted from evidence)

supportAssertions: raw request code is not persisted and the durable request expires at exactly 15 minutes
an analyst cannot approve a request
an active owner creates exactly one 30-minute tenant grant from the one-time request
request replay creates no second grant
owner list returns the tenant grant while an analyst receives no rows
diagnostics return only the fixed aggregate schema
wrong support identity, foreign organization, and foreign owner are concealed
approval and diagnostic use append the expected tenant audit events
revocation is audited and exact revocation replay is idempotent
revoked and expired grants cannot read diagnostics
expired unclaimed requests cannot be approved
application and worker cannot read support tables directly
worker cannot execute support authority functions
direct request or grant mutation is rejected

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The prior owner role was derived from every permission schema value, so a future platform-only permission could silently become tenant-owner authority.
verificationCorrections.correction: Enumerate owner permissions explicitly, replace the unused support:access value with owner-only support:manage, and fail closed if a non-owner membership carries it.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: Domain and tenant tests prove only an active owner can manage grants and future permission additions are not automatically inherited.

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The first complete database sweep applied migrations 0053 and 0054 successfully but found the exact populated-upgrade expectation still ended at migration 0052.
verificationCorrections.correction: Extend the expected upgrade list and ledger count, then assert support forced RLS, function-only application authority, worker denial, and the tenant-composite request-to-grant foreign key.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: The isolated populated 0041-to-0054 upgrade and all 39 database tests pass.

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: A repeat of stateful integration files against an already-populated temporary database replayed fixed bootstrap fixtures and collided with earlier synthetic provider accounts.
verificationCorrections.correction: Confirm the exact temporary cluster data directory, recreate only its explicitly named synthetic reconai database, restore the restricted test-role grants, and rerun once from empty.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: All 11 files and 39 tests pass from the documented clean-database boundary.

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The first full repository gate found five lint issues and the first narrow correction exposed one generic return-type error.
verificationCorrections.correction: Replace control-character regexes with explicit code-point validation, use Record-style timestamp properties, narrow the test row through the existing database string validator, and rerun lint/typecheck/support integration.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: The focused support test and complete repository verification pass.

knownLimitations: No real IdP group, acr mapping, MFA challenge, bypass negative, recovery flow, or support offboarding was exercised.
The ticket reference is supplied by the approving owner and is not validated against a ticket system.
There is no support UI or customer notification workflow.
The 12-hex support identity reference is display-only; authorization uses the full keyed digest.
Expired unclaimed request rows are retained because no approved purge policy exists.
HMAC-key rotation has no overlap window; the documented procedure disables access, revokes or drains grants, waits the maximum lifetime, then rotates.
Multi-replica key consistency, response timing, periodic access review, incident response, protected staging, and production alerting are unverified.
conclusion: The default-disabled restricted-support source boundary and its fresh local PostgreSQL path pass the checked-in acceptance surface. This is local technical evidence only. Goal 1 remains active and restricted support must not be enabled in production until the stated identity, ticketing, notification, access-review, rotation, incident, timing, and protected-staging gates are satisfied.
